SECTION I.

Introduction

The proposed converter partitions the conversion into a coarse SAR stage and a fine stage, which relaxes the comparator noise.

Because the amplifier operates open loop, its gain depends on the transconductance \(g_m\) and the integration time.

SECTION II.

Architecture

A successive-approximation ADC resolves the residue after amplification.
